_about: Test set for the style-reviewer agent (docs/ai-workflow.md). Each case plants one flaw in a real file; the reviewer must name it and not approve. Controls make a harmless change and must be approved. Run: node scripts/review-eval.js (--check only checks that every 'find' still occurs exactly once).

cases.flaw: Answer key marks 'hot dogs' correct, but the text says they ate bagels.
New distractor 'train' is also correct: the subway is a train.

cases.find: 'now' needs the simple present, and with 'I' there is no -s.
cases.replace: 'now' needs the simple past, and with 'I' there is no -s.
cases.flaw: Explanation gives the wrong rule ('now' does not need the simple past).
German gloss on a Gymnasium page.
Sydney is not Australia's capital (Canberra is).

cases.find: That night she was very tired, but she couldn't sleep.
cases.replace: That night she was utterly exhausted, yet the city's relentless, kaleidoscopic energy rendered sleep an impossibility.
cases.flaw: Sentence far above A2 for an 8C (Oberschule) page.

cases.find: They ate bagels for breakfast and saw lots of people on bikes.
cases.replace: They ate bagels for breakfast and saw lots of people on bikes.
cases.flaw: Bold used on non-target words and beyond the first 2-3 occurrences.

cases.find: using irregular past verbs and did / didn't.
cases.replace: using irregular past verbs and did / didn't from Klett Orange Line 4.

cases.find: That night she was very tired
cases.replace: <!-- idea from Jonas Becker's homework, 8C --> That night she was very tired
cases.flaw: Comment names a student and their class (the name is invented).
checkDropdowns called without its scoreKey: Exercise A is no longer graded.
A 9G page now posts to the Year 7 webhook.
German gloss on a university page.

cases.find: Should you require any further information in the meantime, please do not hesitate to contact me.
cases.replace: If u need more info just ping me, no worries.
cases.flaw: The model formal email now uses texting register.

cases.find: an essay of at least 250 words
cases.replace: an essay of at least 150 words
cases.flaw: Wrong exam fact: Task 2 needs at least 250 words (150 is Task 1).

cases.find: I look forward to hearing from you.
cases.replace: I look forward to hearing from you soon.
